 Plan: create plan.txt with "hello" on two lines

 Context

 The user wants a file named plan.txt containing the word hello, written across two lines. Nothing in the repo needs
 to be read first: the task is a single new file in the working directory.

 Approach

 - Target: /private/tmp/herdr-pager-recon/plan.txt (new file; the working directory has no existing plan.txt to
   conflict with).
 - Content, two lines:
   - Line 1: hello
   - Line 2: hello
 - Create it with the Write tool, with exactly those two lines and a trailing newline.

 Interpretation: "containing the word hello, in two lines" is read as two lines, each holding hello. If the user meant
 line 1 hello and line 2 blank, or some other second line, that is a one-line change before writing.

 Verification

 - Read plan.txt back and confirm it has exactly two lines, both hello.
 - Confirm no other files were created or modified.
